title: Latest OTA status per vehicle and campaign
description: Latest OTA state per (vin, campaign_id), built from vehicle.ota.status.v1 (heartbeats ignored). All derivations are in event time and use inputs only: deduplicate by event_id first, ignore arrival order, never read a processing-time clock. Input lateness is at most 300 seconds, so jobs must allow at least 300 seconds of lateness and drop nothing. Keyed by 'vin|campaign_id' (the two values joined by '|', UTF-8) instead of vin: this is a documented exception to VIN keying, because log compaction needs one key per vehicle and campaign. 'Latest' means the ota_status event with the highest producer_seq for that key (equivalently the latest event_time), regardless of arrival order. Jobs may emit intermediate records; parity compares the last record per key.

failure_code.description: Non-null if and only if state = failed.

last_event_id.description: event_id of the event this record reflects.

last_event_time.description: event_time of the event this record reflects.
